name: D.R.I.V.E Karts carry Backseat Beauty and Backseat Babe
contract: The PUR-PL3 D.R.I.V.E Kart 908072 summons kart 110517, which uses two-passenger vehicle 8223.
The client data carries the vehicle and its seats 9996/9997 (attachments 14 and 15, the kart's passenger points), which the harness does not observe.
Mounting seats Backseat Beauty 110522 (bank) and Backseat Babe 110523 (vendor and repair) on the
kart; dismounting removes both. Socketless sessions establish the server-side
passengers, not the client's rendering of the seats.
